<!--
Solve one problem per PR. Split unrelated fixes into separate PRs.
Use a conventional commit title in plain language, such as
"fix: text with emoji no longer comes back garbled".
-->

## Problem

<!-- Explain the problem in a sentence or two. Include what should happen,
what happens instead, and how to reproduce it where relevant.
Link the issue it solves, for example "Closes #10". -->

## Change

<!-- Explain how this fixes the problem. If the change touches both the server
and the client, or several message types, explain why they belong together. -->

## Verification

<!-- Describe what you ran and what you observed for the changed behavior:
the Autobahn cases you ran and their results, a manual check with a WebSocket
client, or both. State anything you could not check. "Tests pass" alone is
not enough. -->
